Test these items: Now(), On Or After precision, On Or Before precision, Same As precision, Same Or After precision, Same Or Before precision, Subtract (left DateTime, right Quantity), Time(hour, minute, second, millisecond), TimeOfDay(), Today(). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.
